title: Story premise ENT111: The Sign at Knee Height
summary: Idea-stage fiction premise (positive public good). Hook: The directions disappear when everyone arrives. Takeaway/theme: Check an instruction from more than one viewpoint.
description: A park volunteer wants all visitors to find a small puppet show, but the only direction sign is hidden behind a crowd’s shoulders. They add a second matching sign on a clear low stand and a visible path symbol, allowing both tall and short cartoon visitors to follow the same route.
